svg.title: PROBABILISTIC DATA STRUCTURES: sketchnote
svg.text: Trade a small, known error for a tiny fraction of the memory.
~10 bits per item ≈ 1% false "yes" · never a false "no"
Is X in the set? "Definitely not" or "probably yes". ~10 bits per
How often? +1 in each row, read the minimum. Never
each keeps the max run seen
How many distinct? Leading-zero runs across 16k registers:
Bloom: no deletes, size for the expected
HLL: approximate only; never for billing
Say the error and why it is acceptable
"Seen URLs live in a Bloom filter: 10 billion at 1%
is about 12 GB, and a false positive just skips a
page. Unique viewers per video use HyperLogLog:
12 KB each, under 1% error, and hourly sketches
